Quick triage notes (initial):
- Observed spike in request queueing on canary pool (pool id: canary-usw2-17) beginning 08:46 PDT.
- CPU on host shard 17 elevated ~80% and worker threads show significant backpressure while KV cache hit-rate dropped ~12%.
- P95/P99 degradation correlates with requests that hit the longer-sequence path in the new kernel (v2-canary) — appears to be a code path regression under certain seq-len distributions.
- Error rate increased from 0.03% -> 0.9% (502/504) for the canary pool only.

Actionable: I can snapshot perf traces and recommend rollback of rwd-model-v2-canary -> rwd-model-v1-default for production routing. If we rollback, we'll need a short maintenance window to rebuild warmed KV caches to avoid transient spikes.

Attaching perf dump and initial flame graphs.

-Marcus
Lead SRE, Serving Runtime
